nodes.label: Access Policy (paywall scoring)
nodes.rationale: Preselection scoring prefers free sources and meaningfully penalizes paywalled ones; high-impact paywalled stories are never automatically excluded.

nodes.label: Per-Server-Start CSRF Token (POST /api/review)
nodes.rationale: Stops another browser tab from silently triggering review actions against the local queue while the console is open — a real risk for any unauthenticated localhost server.

nodes.label: ainwa-discovery.yml as Operational Discovery Registry
nodes.rationale: Registry is the source of truth for ingestion; review console intentionally does not read it to keep review and discovery as separate AINWA stages.

nodes.label: approved.locked = true Publishing Boundary
nodes.rationale: Signals human approval has occurred; downstream automation must never regenerate locked editorial fields, enforcing human authority over final published content.

nodes.label: Multilingual Readiness (v1 Compatibility Hooks)
nodes.rationale: Data model is structurally multilingual-ready so a future translation stage can be added without a schema migration; v1 always writes source_language=en and empty localizations.

nodes.label: Source URL Scheme Validation (http/https only)
nodes.rationale: Prevents javascript: or other non-http(s) URLs landing in source.url from executing; validated both server-side and client-side as defense in depth.
